borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The proposed development would result in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. While it would provide a dwelling in the form of an HMO, it fails to demonstrate that this meets an identified need, would cause a loss of local amenity including to neighbouring occupiers, and would not be located in an area with a high PTAL rating. As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's housing supply and is contrary to the following policies: National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)Policies D6, D14 and T4 of the London Plan (March 2021)Policies SP3, SP8, DMD1, DMT1, DMH5 and DMSI3 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan (September 2024)

The proposed development fails to demonstrate that additional demand for parking from the development could be adequately accommodated in the surrounding area. The proposal is therefore likely to add unacceptably to parking stress and congestion in the vicinity of the application site.  As such, it fails to comply with the following policies which seek to ensure proposals show how car parking will be designed and managed and to take into consideration on-street parking availability and existing and planned public transport provision: National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, December 2024)Policies T1 and T6.1 of the London Plan (March 2021) Policy DMT2 of the Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024)
description: Change of use of the dwelling (C3) to a 4-bedroom HMO (C4) including the construction of a single storey rear extension and alterations to the rear fenestration
